messages:
alex: Quick thread on version-history diffs in the timeline. Main asks: lightweight diff peek, keyboard-friendly expand/collapse, and safer copy for 'Preview rollback'. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl/version-history (internal). Thoughts?
rhea: Love the diff peek idea. Instead of a full modal, show an inline accordion under the snapshot row with a 2-line summary and a 'Show full diff' link. Keep the primary timeline density intact.
tom: Keyboard nav: when a snapshot row is focused, space/enter should toggle the diff peek. Right arrow to open the full diff panel, left arrow to close. Also support 'd' as a shortcut for diff peek. Document these in the keyboard help modal.
priya: Copy nit: 'Preview rollback' reads like a destructive action. Suggest 'Preview changes before rollback' for the button and make the rollback CTA explicit as 'Rollback and Route Traffic'. Also add a confirmation step that lists affected services.
a11y-bot: A11y checklist: accordion must be a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Announce diff peek content with aria-live="polite" when it opens. Ensure full diff panel gets focus when opened and focus returns to the snapshot row when closed. Color contrast for added/removed lines must meet 4.5:1 for text.
alex: For the inline summary, can we show commit author + short commit message + 1-line bullet of changed files (e.g., '+ api, - docs')? Hover shows full commit SHA and timestamp.
rhea: Visual: for the small diff peek use a mono font for file names and show +/- inline badges with colored chips but also icons (plus/minus) so color isn't the only indicator.
tom: Tiny code snippet for ARIA: <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="diff-1847500123" aria-describedby="diff-summary-1847500123">Show changes</button>. When opened set aria-expanded to true and focus the panel.
priya: Also add a compact mode toggle for history where rows collapse to a single line and diffs are lazy-loaded only on demand. This helps accounts with huge histories. Add a 'Load more snapshots' button at the bottom rather than infinite scroll to prevent accidental keyboard focus jumps.
a11y-bot: For keyboard shortcuts, provide a help overlay listing them and ensure shortcuts are discoverable via a '?' key. Also allow shortcut customization in user settings. Announce when a shortcut is triggered.
alex: UX detail: show a small inline diff indicator on the timeline scrubber (a dot with a tiny glyph) so users can spot snapshots with code changes vs config-only snapshots. Tooltip shows commit message.
release-bot: release-bot: snapshot annotated: commit=fa3b2c ts=1847500180 user=ci-pipeline
rhea: Action items: Tom to spec keyboard interactions and shortcut doc, Priya to update copy and confirmation flow, Alex to wireframe inline commit summary, A11y-bot to produce ARIA checklist and contrast specs. We'll review in crit next Tue. Thanks!
